description:
AgentDeck turns Stream Deck and Stream Deck + into a live control surface for AI coding agents.

AgentDeck 2.0 keeps session identity and original choices clear. Session keys show Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Kiro, Antigravity and Hermes activity: who is working and who needs your attention. Hermes sessions are read-only. Controls appear only when the daemon and integration support them.

Select a session, answer supported original choices and one-time approval requests, change a supported mode or stop a supported session. Human Attention is kept separate from CI waits. Same-project sessions retain distinct tags, narrow keys stay readable, and stale requests are retired.

Usage dials follow the windows Claude and Codex actually report, with reset countdowns. The other dials control system volume and launch agent apps. Session keys and usage work on macOS and Windows; browser-tab focusing is available on macOS.

Profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck + and Stream Deck + XL are bundled. The + XL uses four assigned dials; its two extra dials remain unassigned.

Getting set up
The plugin is a thin client and needs the free AgentDeck daemon on the same computer. On macOS, use the free AgentDeck app from the Mac App Store. On macOS or Windows, you can instead run:

npx @agentdeck/setup

Enable the integrations you use, then launch coding agents normally. Observation-only sessions remain read-only. After updating the native app and CLI together, refresh enabled integrations and review changed Codex hook trust when prompted.

The plugin bundles no daemon and collects no analytics. AgentDeck is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elgato, Anthropic, OpenAI or other named parties. All trademarks belong to their owners.
releaseNotes: AgentDeck 2.0 preserves original request choices and session identity, improves readable session labels, Attention and option paging, reconnect/teardown behavior and usage freshness. Update the daemon/installer too; available controls depend on the integration. Refreshed icon and current-renderer gallery.
